before: A custom mechanic in this game is the horizontal dash. While holding either the left or right arrow key, the player can press Space to instantly move 80 px in the corresponding horizontal direction.
after: A custom mechanic in this game is the horizontal dash. While holding either the left or right arrow key, the player can press Space to instantly move 120 px in the corresponding horizontal direction.
Exactly two obstacle blocks are created simultaneously at each obstacle spawn event.
At each obstacle spawn event, exactly two obstacles are created simultaneously.
Their initial rectangles must not overlap each other.
Exactly two obstacles are created during each obstacle spawn event.
For each pair:
- Both obstacles have top-left y-coordinate y = 100.
- Each obstacle independently uses a random integer top-left x-coordinate from 0 to 560 inclusive.
- The two initial obstacle rectangles must not overlap.
If a randomly selected x-coordinate would cause the second obstacle to overlap the first obstacle at spawn time, another x-coordinate must be selected until a non-overlapping placement is obtained.

before: If the left arrow key is held, pressing Space instantly moves the player 80 px to the left.
If the right arrow key is held, pressing Space instantly moves the player 80 px to the right.
after: If the left arrow key is held, pressing Space instantly moves the player 120 px to the left.
If the right arrow key is held, pressing Space instantly moves the player 120 px to the right.

before: Exactly one new obstacle is spawned every 1 second while the game state is `playing`.
after: Exactly two new obstacles are spawned simultaneously every 1 second while the game state is `playing`.
For each obstacle:
The two obstacles generated during the same spawn event must not overlap each other at spawn time.
Their horizontal positions are otherwise selected independently.

before: A successful dash instantly moves the player 80 px in the currently held horizontal direction.
after: A successful dash instantly moves the player 120 px in the currently held horizontal direction.
1. Apply the 120 px horizontal displacement.

before: The obstacle spawn timer advances continuously. Exactly one obstacle is created whenever the fixed 1-second spawn interval is reached, and each active obstacle moves downward at 200 px/s.
after: The obstacle spawn timer advances continuously. Exactly two non-overlapping obstacles are created simultaneously whenever the fixed 1-second spawn interval is reached, and each active obstacle moves downward at 200 px/s.
- Obstacles per spawn event: 2
- Dash distance: 120 px
